color.themeMarker: 可选对话适配层使用的窗口级 Prism 配色标记，不用于可见界面颜色。
command.chooseLanguage: 选择扩展语言 / Choose Extension Language
command.showCompatibilityReport: 查看 Antigravity 兼容性报告
setting.language:
Theme Studio、扩展对话框与报告的语言。自动模式跟随编辑器显示语言。原生设置的说明和选项始终提供中英双语，行标题由 IDE 根据设置键名生成。本选项不修改 IDE 的显示语言。

Language for Theme Studio, extension dialogs and reports. Auto follows the editor display language. Native Settings descriptions and choices stay bilingual; the IDE generates row headings from setting IDs. This does not change the IDE display language.
setting.accent:
Prism 主题强调色。默认随各配色变化。

Accent color for Prism themes. Default follows each palette.
setting.customAccent:
自定义强调色，格式为 #RRGGBB；强调色选择 Custom 时生效。

Custom accent in #RRGGBB format. Used when Accent is Custom.
setting.contrast:
标准 Prism 边界或加强边界与次要文字对比度；不替代 VS Code 高对比主题。

Standard Prism borders or stronger borders and secondary text. Does not replace a VS Code High Contrast theme.
setting.contrast.option.high: 加强边界与文字对比 / Stronger borders and text
setting.sidebarSurface:
侧栏与 Antigravity 对话共用底色：Prism 分层、与编辑区一致、或淡强调色。也影响资源管理器与活动栏，无法只隔离聊天侧栏。

Shared sidebar and Antigravity conversation canvas: Prism layers, editor-matched background, or a subtle accent tint. Also changes Explorer and Activity Bar; cannot isolate the chat sidebar.
setting.sidebarSurface.option.unified: 与编辑区一致 / Match editor
setting.inputBorder:
Antigravity 聊天输入框之外的原生输入控件共用边框。Accent 使用清晰的强调色边线。已检查的 Antigravity 客户端自行生成聊天输入框外框，不使用此颜色。

Shared native input border outside the Antigravity composer. Accent adds a visible focus-color outline. The inspected Antigravity clients derive their own composer frames and do not consume this color.
setting.chatBackground:
Antigravity 可选对话外观适配器的背景效果。仅在单独执行“启用对话外观”命令后生效；保存或导入此偏好不会启用适配器。

Background effect for the optional Antigravity chat appearance adapter. Requires the separate Enable Chat Appearance command; saving or importing this preference never enables the adapter.
setting.chatBackground.option.auroraText: 极光与纹理 / Aurora with texture
setting.chatBackgroundIntensity:
Antigravity 可选对话外观适配器的背景效果强度。仅在单独执行“启用对话外观”命令后生效；保存或导入此偏好不会启用适配器。

Background effect intensity for the optional Antigravity chat appearance adapter. Requires the separate Enable Chat Appearance command; saving or importing this preference never enables the adapter.
setting.chatComposerStyle:
Antigravity 可选对话外观适配器的输入区样式；Native 保留宿主样式。仅在单独执行“启用对话外观”命令后生效；保存或导入此偏好不会启用适配器。

Composer styling for the optional Antigravity chat appearance adapter. Native retains the host style. Requires the separate Enable Chat Appearance command; saving or importing this preference never enables the adapter.
setting.chatModelStyle:
Antigravity 可选对话外观适配器的模型选择器样式；Native 保留宿主样式。仅在单独执行“启用对话外观”命令后生效；保存或导入此偏好不会启用适配器。

Model selector styling for the optional Antigravity chat appearance adapter. Native retains the host style. Requires the separate Enable Chat Appearance command; saving or importing this preference never enables the adapter.
setting.chatMotion:
Antigravity 可选对话外观适配器的动效，默认关闭。仅在单独执行“启用对话外观”命令后生效；保存或导入此偏好不会启用适配器。

Motion for the optional Antigravity chat appearance adapter. Off by default. Requires the separate Enable Chat Appearance command; saving or importing this preference never enables the adapter.
setting.italicComments:
在 Prism 主题中使用斜体注释。

Use italic comments in Prism themes.
setting.boldKeywords:
在 Prism 主题中使用粗体关键字。

Use bold keywords in Prism themes.
setting.codeFont:
字体偏好。运行“应用编辑器排版”后全局生效；Default 恢复原字体。不下载字体。

Font preference. Run Apply Editor Typography to apply globally. Default restores your previous font. Fonts are not downloaded.
setting.codeFont.option.default: 保留编辑器字体 / Keep editor font
setting.ligatures:
连字偏好。仅在“应用编辑器排版”后生效；Inherit 恢复原值。

Ligature preference. Applied only by Apply Editor Typography; Inherit restores your previous value.
setting.ligatures.option.inherit: 保留原设置 / Keep previous setting
setting.smoothCaret:
平滑光标偏好。仅在“应用编辑器排版”后生效。

Smooth cursor preference. Applied only by Apply Editor Typography.
setting.smoothCaret.option.inherit: 保留原设置 / Keep previous setting
setting.smoothScrolling:
编辑器平滑滚动偏好。仅在“应用编辑器排版”后生效。

Smooth editor scrolling preference. Applied only by Apply Editor Typography.
setting.smoothScrolling.option.inherit: 保留原设置 / Keep previous setting
setting.cornerStyle:
仅调整 Theme Studio 面板内的圆角，VS Code 主界面保留原生圆角。

Corner style inside Theme Studio only. VS Code workbench corners remain native.
setting.ambientIntensity:
仅调整 Theme Studio 面板内的环境光强度。

Ambient glow intensity inside Theme Studio only.
setting.motion:
仅调整 Theme Studio 面板内的动效；优先遵循系统减少动态效果偏好。

Motion inside Theme Studio only. System reduced-motion preferences take priority.
setting.preferredDark:
“应用系统明暗外观”使用的深色配色；仅保存偏好不会启用自动切换。

Dark palette for Apply System Appearance. Saving this preference alone does not enable auto switching.
setting.preferredLight:
“应用系统明暗外观”使用的浅色配色；仅保存偏好不会启用自动切换。

Light palette for Apply System Appearance. Saving this preference alone does not enable auto switching.
